answer: Cosignatures are collected in crystal, verified in sparrow, and comet names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 18 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 46 aliases cost 145 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
